EmailTemplate.name: Q1 Client Check In Invite
EmailTemplate.subject: Let's schedule our Q1 call to discuss 2018 investment plans..
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
I hope you are having a great start to 2018.
I wanted to reach out to you here in the month of January, and my thought it that it would be a good idea for us to jump on a 5-10 minute call (longer if needed, obviously) just to touch base and talk about your investment plans for the first half of this year.
Please use this link to schedule a call with me on the day/time of your choosing, and feel free to reply to this email if you want to send over specific questions, topics, etc., that you would like to cover on our call.
For your convenience, I am attaching a typical property from each of our 5 markets so that you can get your bearings as to the typical price points and returns for each markets, and to make it EVEN easier, here is a quick summary:
Memphis & Little Rock: $100-150k price range, most properties right around 7% net cash on cash return (unleveraged). little to no appreciation. our "steady eddie" markets.
Oklahoma City: $125-175k, with most properties yielding 6.5% to 7% on a cash purchase. moderate growth potential for rents and property values.
Dallas and Houston: $150-200k, with ROI ranging from 5.75%-6.5% on average. high growth potential, ESPECIALLY at such an affordable entry point of $150k.
I'm looking forward to assisting you to build upon your portfolio with our team in 2018.
Sincerely,
Marq
